parsed.why: National seat: no local bathroom ban but a national-legislature facility restriction attached and un-repealable locally; low-risk assessment yet overridable; local protections, hate-crime, marker, police and custody practice all undocumented, so unresolved rather than protective.

Statutory public-accommodations and hate-crime coverage of gender identity in force, panic-defence repeal, gender-neutral single-user bathrooms, and sanction/shield laws enforceable against out-of-state action; only the shared national border regime and override risk cap it.

Gender identity protected in public accommodations, hate-crime coverage and panic-defence repeal in force, no adult facility ban; school and minor-targeted restrictions and thin enforcement data keep it a step below the shield-law jurisdiction.

Visitor-reaching facility ban in government-owned buildings enforced by public complaints, defence requiring documents visitors lack, no public-accommodations protection; only hate-crime coverage and non-criminal process mitigate.
